$comment: Canonical version + lifecycle policy for ClearCutt runtime lines. EDIT THIS FILE (core/lib/version-policy.json); cli/internal/versionpolicy/version-policy.json is a byte-identical mirror embedded in the CLI binary and enforced by TestVersionPolicyMirrorMatchesCanonical. Channels: lts/current are production-eligible (status=active); preview is opt-in (status=preview, only via --allow-preview); experimental marks toolchain lines (status=experimental, support=unsupported). omitInProduction marks toolchain languages whose runtime is not shipped in production tiers (mirrors registry.nix) and are therefore never productionAllowed. This is the single source of truth for runtime-line classification; the Nix flake reads it starting in the fleet-compilation work.
